tool_args.rationale: The archived Hill-2 inhibition law matches both pilot signatures, and five measurements with widely varying input and gradient constrain its four static parameters. Fit them numerically and seek fresh confirmation rather than purchasing an unneeded probe.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed sink-gradient span is 2.0, far above the stated 0.08 threshold, so this probe is not indicated before fitting.
The observed sigmoidal onset and sink-gradient signature favor the archived cooperative Hill mechanism; fresh confirmation will test it.
The pilot does not suggest a coupled memory ODE requiring trajectory measurements.
